description: We’re 4 Electronics & Mechatronics Engineering students with hands-on experience designing, building and programming CubeSats and planning aerospace missions. We’re currently developing the OBC, EPS and COMMS systems for a satellite. Self-taught and driven by logic, hard engineering and passion. We see this hackathon as a chance to sharpen our front-end skills beyond hardware and firmware. If you bring commitment and an engineering mindset, you’ll fit right in!
